description: Executed trades for a market ticker, live OR long-settled. Returns most-recent N trades with yes/no price in BOTH units (yes_price_cents and yes_price_dollars at full precision), contract size, taker side and timestamp. Useful for sanity-checking what the market actually paid vs the resting orderbook, and for reconstructing how a resolved market traded. Kalshi answers 200-with-an-empty-list on its live trades endpoint for markets it has archived, so this falls through to Kalshi's historical trade archive and reports which one answered in `source`.
name: kalshi_trades
